leakage_prevention: Buckets are UTC floors aligned to 00:00 and every timeframe divides 1440 minutes, so no bucket straddles a day or a year. A bar with open T and span S is observable only from T+S; closed_bars_asof() is the only accessor that should feed a strategy and it is truncation invariant.
